title: experiment.plan_ready (v1)
description: ExperimentPlannerAgent has finished planning the experiment and frozen an ExperimentPlan into the Research Store (see agents/experiment_planner_agent/data-contracts/experiment_plan.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the plan is read from the Research Store by ref. ExperimentPlannerAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M8) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

experiment_plan_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ExperimentPlan object.
